# Third-party prebuilt native libraries that are NOT yet 16 KB page-size aligned.
# Used by scripts/check-16kb-alignment.sh. Format: <abi>/<libname.so>
#
# Policy:
# - Libraries built in this repository (ndk-build modules in
#   ZalithLauncher/src/main/jni, PetLib's Rust cdylib) must NEVER be listed here;
#   they are built with -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384.
# - Each entry below is a third-party prebuilt. TODO(upstream): ask the owning
#   project to rebuild with 16 KB alignment, then delete the entry. The check
#   reports entries that have become compliant as "stale".
# - Measured with `readelf -lW` (LOAD p_align = 0x1000) on 2026-11-01, commit cbf877a.

# --- ZalithLauncher/src/main/jniLibs (prebuilt) -----------------------------

arm64-v8a/libOSMesa_8.so
x86_64/libOSMesa_2121.so
x86_64/libOSMesa_2300d.so
x86_64/libOSMesa_8.so
# TODO(upstream): gl4es 1.1.4

# TODO(upstream): shader converter used by the GL4ES path

# --- NDK toolchain (UNVERIFIED) ---------------------------------------------
# libc++_shared.so is copied from NDK r25.2 by ndk-build (APP_STL := c++_shared).
# Its alignment depends on the NDK release and could not be measured locally.
# If the check reports this entry as stale, delete it. Otherwise it resolves when
# ndkVersion is raised to a release that ships a 16 KB-aligned libc++_shared.so.
arm64-v8a/libc++_shared.so
x86_64/libc++_shared.so
